en: Black-and-white postcard showing an urban street scene with strong brick Expressionist office blocks. On the left is a sharply pointed, ship-like building with arcades at ground level, and on the right another large brick office block with many small windows. Cars and trucks from the early 20th century are parked on the street. In the distant background a church spire rises over the city. Printed text at the bottom reads "Hamburg. Chilehaus und Sprinkenhof" and a small number "3172" appears in the corner.
